title: Canonical Theta Correlation Bound: Arithmetic Derivation, Certified Tests, and a Proof Attempt

section_2_seed_defect_and_mellin_audit.holomorphy_strip_s: Re(s) > -2 (first uncancelled Gamma pole at s = -2)

endpoint_values.s_eq_0_mechanism: Gamma(s/2) = 2/s - gamma_E + O(s) has a simple pole at s = 0; the double factor s^2 cancels the pole and leaves a simple zero F_tau(s) = (1/16) s + O(s^2).
endpoint_values.s_eq_1_mechanism: Gamma(1/2) = sqrt(pi) is finite and (s - 1)^2 vanishes to order 2 at s = 1.

critical_strip_nonvanishing.proof: On 0 < Re(s) < 1, s != 0, s != 1, (tau/2)^(-s/2) = exp(-(s/2) log(pi)) != 0, and Gamma(s/2) has no zeros in C; hence F_tau(s) != 0 everywhere on 0 < Re(s) < 1.

equivalent_statements.statement_A_canonical_correlation_bound: C_tau(0) >= 0 and |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) for every K in Qbar intersect R
equivalent_statements.statement_B_two_by_two_gram_determinant: C_tau(0) >= 0 and Delta_tau(K) := C_tau(0)^2 - |C_tau(K)|^2 >= 0 for every K in Qbar intersect R
equivalent_statements.statement_C_cyclic_trajectory_cauchy_sch: <psi_tau, psi_tau>_xi >= 0 and |<T_K psi_tau, psi_tau>_xi|^2 <= <T_K psi_tau, T_K psi_tau>_xi <psi_tau, psi_tau>_xi along the cyclic trajectory {T_K psi_tau}
equivalent_statements.statement_D_riemann_hypothesis: Every nontrivial zero rho of zeta(s) in 0 < Re(s) < 1 satisfies Re(rho) = 1/2

laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_1_density_and_continuity: Because K |-> C_tau(K) = sum_rho m_rho a_rho tau^{-K(rho - 1/2)} is continuous on R (by uniform normal convergence on compact K-intervals from Stirling decay |a_rho| << |gamma|^{15/2} exp(-pi|gamma|/2)) and Qbar intersect R is dense in R, |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) on Qbar intersect R implies |C_tau(t)| <= C_tau(0) for all t in R.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_2_normal_convergence_of_partial_fra: For Re(w) > L/2, int_0^infty e^{-wt} tau^{t(rho - 1/2)} dt = 1 / (w - L(rho - 1/2)). Since sum_rho m_rho |a_rho| < infty, the partial-fraction series R_tau(w) := sum_rho m_rho a_rho / (w - L(rho - 1/2)) converges normally on every compact subset of C \ {L(rho - 1/2)} and coincides with the Laplace transform L[C_tau(-t)](w) = int_0^infty e^{-wt} C_tau(-t) dt on Re(w) > L/2.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_3_right_half_plane_holomorphy_from_: Under |C_tau(-t)| <= C_tau(0) for all t >= 0, the Laplace integral L[C_tau(-t)](w) converges absolutely and defines a holomorphic function on the entire open right half-plane Re(w) > 0, with |L[C_tau(-t)](w)| <= C_tau(0) / Re(w).
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_4_nonvanishing_simple_pole_residue: If zeta(s) had a zero rho_0 = 1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0 with 0 < delta_0 < 1/2, then w_0 := L(rho_0 - 1/2) = L*delta_0 + i*L*gamma_0 lies in Re(w) = L*delta_0 > 0. Because the map rho |-> w_rho = L(rho - 1/2) is injective on C, no other distinct zero rho != rho_0 shares the pole point w_0; the residue of R_tau(w) at w = w_0 is m_{rho_0} a_{rho_0} = m_{rho_0} F_tau(rho_0) conj(F_tau(1 - conj(rho_0))) != 0 (since m_{rho_0} >= 1 and F_tau(s) != 0 on 0 < Re(s) < 1), contradicting holomorphy on Re(w) > 0.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_5_functional_equation_reflection: If rho_0 = 1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0 had -1/2 < delta_0 < 0, the functional equation xi(1 - s) = xi(s) supplies the reflected zero rho_0' = 1 - conj(rho_0) = 1/2 - delta_0 + i*gamma_0 with Re(rho_0' - 1/2) = -delta_0 > 0, reducing to Step 4.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_6_converse_under_rh: Under RH, every nontrivial zero has rho = 1/2 + i*gamma_rho, so 1 - conj(rho) = rho, a_rho = |F_tau(1/2 + i*gamma_rho)|^2 > 0, and C_tau(0) = sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 > 0. For every real K, |C_tau(K)| = |sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 tau^{-i K gamma_rho L}| <= sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 = C_tau(0).

local_concavity_and_derivatives.taylor_concavity_inequality: Zero-free 6th-order Taylor enclosure certifies -C_tau(0) < C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.051486 (and C_tau(K) > 0 on |K| <= 0.045776); unconditional spectral-tail 4th-order Taylor enclosure certifies -C_tau(0) < C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.068465 (C_tau(K) > 0 on |K| <= 0.050851, and C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.133277).

finite_toeplitz_gram_matrices.comparison_2x2_vs_NxN: Positive-definiteness of the N x N Toeplitz Gram matrices is certified via outward-rounded leading principal minor determinants (`flint.arb_mat.det()`, Sylvester's criterion) on the full Arb enclosures. Moreover, even a finite uniform bound |C_tau(K)| <= M < infty suffices to make the Laplace transform holomorphic on Re(w) > 0 and imply RH.

section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.scaling_identity: C_{a,b}(K) = sqrt(a_0 / a) * C_{a_0,tau}(K * log(b) / log(tau)), where a_0 = tau/2 = pi
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.physical_space_mechanism: Because psi_a(x) = x^{1/2} P_2(a x^2) exp(-a x^2) = (a_0/a)^{1/4} psi_tau(sqrt(a/a_0) x), multiplicative convolution with Haar measure dy/y is scale-invariant in y and factors out ((a_0/a)^{1/4})^2 = sqrt(a_0/a), while b^K x = tau^{(K log b / log tau)} x.
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.spectral_space_mechanism: In Mellin space, F_a(s) = (a_0 / a)^{s/2} F_tau(s), so on every zero pair (rho, 1 - conj(rho)) where rho + (1 - rho) = 1, the product F_a(rho) conj(F_a(1 - conj(rho))) = (a_0/a)^{1/2} a_rho scales by sqrt(a_0/a) independently of rho.
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.tau_role_implication: Replacing b = tau by any b > 1 merely reparametrizes the real grade line K |-> K log(b)/log(tau), and replacing a = pi by a > 0 scales C_{a,b} by sqrt(pi/a). Therefore, any arithmetic proof of |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) must either establish the inequality for all real shifts kappa = K log(tau) in R or exploit the specific self-dual Poisson/modular coupling between the archimedean factor pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) and the integer lattice Z at a = pi = tau/2.

attempt_1_pointwise_kernel_difference.obstruction_mechanism: For K = 1, h_0(3) > 0 gives d_1^-(3) = +0.248918 > 0 at prime p = 3, whereas at prime p = 7 near tau = 2*pi ~ 6.2832, h_0(7/tau) ~ h_0(1) = +0.49736 > 0 and h_0(7) < 0 give d_1^-(7) = -0.401751 < 0, ruling out term-by-term prime-sum dominance.

attempt_2_local_concavity_and_archimedea.conclusion: At K = 0, BOTH the completed archimedean sector (-0.257595 < 0, arising from -167.403799 archimedean integral curvature + 167.146204 local constant curvature) AND the prime-power sector (-0.384145 < 0) are strictly concave, reinforcing each other to give C_tau''(0) = -0.641740 < 0. The 100% zero-free arithmetic 6th-order Taylor enclosure certifies -C_tau(0) < C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.051486 (and C_tau(K) > 0 on |K| <= 0.045776), while the unconditional spectral-tail 4th-order Taylor enclosure certifies -C_tau(0) < C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.068465 and C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.133277.

asymptotic_rates_for_K_gt_0.archimedean_integral_term: O(tau^{-3K/2}) because the leading O(tau^{K/2}) moment int_0^infty h_0(alpha) alpha^{-1/2} d_alpha/alpha = H_0(-1/2) = 0 vanishes identically
asymptotic_rates_for_K_gt_0.reflected_prime_wavelet_sum_P_refl: -sum_{n>=2} (Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)) h_0(n / tau^K), whose PNT smooth main term tau^{K/2} int_0^infty h_0(alpha) alpha^{1/2} d_alpha/alpha = tau^{K/2} H_0(1/2) = 0 vanishes identically by F_tau(1) = 0, leaving an O(1) oscillatory prime-error wavelet transform

uniform_prime_wavelet_boundedness.simplified_target_statement: exists M < infty forall X >= 1 : |W_wavelet(X)| := |sum_{n >= 2} (Lambda(n) / sqrt(n)) h_0(n / X)| <= M

equivalence_to_complete_correlation_boun.laplace_sufficiency: Any uniform bound |W_wavelet(X)| <= M < infty implies |C_tau(K)| <= M_arch + M_fwd + M < infty for all K in R, which bounds the Laplace transform |L[C_tau(-t)](w)| <= M_total / Re(w) on Re(w) > 0, preventing right-half-plane poles and implying the Riemann Hypothesis.

stieltjes_chebyshev_error_representation.derivative_wavelet_kernel_formula: tilde{h}_0(alpha) = (1/2) h_0(alpha) - (D_alpha h_0)(alpha), D_alpha = alpha d/d_alpha
stieltjes_chebyshev_error_representation.exact_stieltjes_identity: W_wavelet(X) = h_0(1/X) - int_0^1 x^{-1/2} h_0(x/X) dx + X^{-1/2} int_1^infty (E_psi(x)/x) tilde{h}_0(x/X) dx/x^{1/2},  E_psi(x) = psi(x) - x

unconditional_bounds_comparison.de_la_vallee_poussin_pnt_bound: O(X^{1/2} exp(-c sqrt(log X))) (cancels main term x via H_0(1/2) = 0, but triangle inequality inside the integral loses oscillatory cancellation of E_psi)
unconditional_bounds_comparison.uniform_O_1_target: O(1) for all X >= 1 (requires bounding the wavelet pairing of E_psi(x)/sqrt(x) against tilde{h}_0(x/X) without taking absolute values inside the integral)

attempt_3_large_grade_wavelet_decomposit.why_large_K_is_not_trivially_suppressed: While the forward prime sum P_fwd(K) and archimedean term W_arch(h_K) decay exponentially in K > 0, the reflected prime sum P_refl(K) = -sum_{n>=2} (Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)) h_0(n/tau^K) sweeps its peak alpha = n/tau^K = 1 across all primes n ~ tau^K as K -> +infty. Because ANY finite uniform bound |C_tau(K)| <= M < infty suffices for right-half-plane Laplace holomorphy, the problem reduces to uniform boundedness of W_wavelet(X) for X >= 1.

exact_remaining_subgate.exact_statement: Prove without invoking RH or Weil positivity that for every K in Qbar intersect R, |W_arch(h_K) - sum_{n>=2} (Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)) [h_0(tau^K n) + h_0(tau^{-K} n)]| <= C_tau(0), or establish the simplified uniform prime-wavelet bound (SUBGATE-TC-042B): exists M < infty forall X >= 1 : |sum_{n>=2} (Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)) h_0(n/X)| <= M.

simplified_wavelet_subgate.exact_statement: exists M < infty forall X >= 1 : |W_wavelet(X)| := |sum_{n >= 2} (Lambda(n) / sqrt(n)) h_0(n / X)| <= M
